brief:
Kinaan Dadou was seven years old when a Hamas rocket detonated near him on October 7, 2023, leaving him disabled. His parents have since struggled to secure funding for specialist care, according to The Guardian. The family's efforts to access treatment have so far failed to yield the medical support they seek.

Kinaan remains without access to the specialized intervention his parents believe he needs. His case is one among many Palestinians injured during the conflict who face barriers to obtaining adequate medical treatment and financial assistance for their care.
dek: Kinaan Dadou, 10, has been left disabled since 7 October 2023 as his parents struggle to find funding for specialist treatment It was 7.30am on 7 October 2023 when a Hamas rocket exploded next to 7-year-old Kinaan Dadou.
title: Family seeks treatment funds for boy injured by Hamas rocket
